context.transcript:
Excuse me, when will our food be ready?
A. The chef created the menu.
B. A new microwave.
C. The kitchen is really busy.
context.transcript_translation:
对不起，我们的食物什么时候能准备好？
A. 厨师创建了菜单。
B. 一个新的微波炉。
C. 厨房非常忙。

items.question: Excuse me, when will our food be ready?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“Excuse me, when will our food be ready?”，自然应答是“The kitchen is really busy.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：C（The kitchen is really busy.）。
